claim_text: A USDA official says it was a cyberthreat, not a software update
summary: USDA's under secretary for farm production and conservation told reporters the week-long disruption was a 'cyberthreat' and not a 'software update'.
detail: DTN and AgWeb each report his remarks from press events. We found no written USDA statement, and DTN says USDA's press office had not responded.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Two outlets that were not copying each other report the official's on-the-record remarks.

claim_text: An outside actor got into the farmer-payment system
summary: NBC News, citing sources, says hackers accessed the system that pays farmers. ABC News says one source named the farmer-payment tool as one system affected.
detail: The sources are anonymous. USDA's under secretary says protective systems worked and 'people that were trying to do harm weren't able to do it', which does not fit a successful break-in.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Two outlets cite anonymous sources; the official account points the other way.

summary: Nobody has been named. Nextgov says it is not clear who carried out the intrusion. We found no claim of responsibility.
label: Not established

summary: Nextgov says it is not clear whether any data was copied out. USDA's under secretary says no data was lost.
detail: The official statement has not been checked by anyone outside USDA.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: The reporting and the official statement do not settle the question.

claim_text: USDA found a security incident and reset all database passwords
summary: Nextgov says an internal email sent Monday said USDA's cyber operations center 'uncovered a security incident' and that all database passwords in all environments had to be reset, which forced application restarts and caused outages.
detail: Nextgov viewed the email. DTN repeats the report from Nextgov, so it counts as one source.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: One outlet saw the email and quotes it.

claim_text: Some outages may have another cause
summary: The under secretary also said some Farm Service Agency systems could have been down because of maintenance, and that 'there could be multiple reasons'.
label: Reported

claim_text: Farm loan, payment and mapping tools went down
summary: DTN reports outages since Monday in FSA's loan software, NRCS's ProTracts program, which releases farmer payments, and a service desk tool used to map projects. The under secretary acknowledged delays to farmer loans and payments.
detail: Nextgov reports that many financial tools for payments between the agency and farmers were affected.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The official acknowledges the delays and three outlets describe the affected tools.

claim_text: The disruption began around Monday, Nov 16
summary: The internal email Nextgov saw is dated Monday, Nov 16, ABC says a notice went out Monday, and DTN says employees reported outages from Monday. The under secretary called it a week-long event on Friday.
detail: NBC says the agency told employees on Thursday, which may be a later notice. The sources disagree on who was told what, and when.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Three outlets point to Monday for the start of the outages.

claim_text: The under secretary says no personal information was involved
summary: He said there was no personally identifiable information involved and no data was lost, because protective systems worked.
detail: This is his statement to reporters. It has not been checked by anyone outside USDA.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: DTN and AgWeb both report the statement.

claim_text: Most systems expected back by Friday night or over the weekend
summary: The under secretary said most systems should be back online by close of business on Friday, Nov 20, and if not, work would continue over the weekend.
detail: We have not seen a report that they are back.
label: Confirmed

summary: We found no report as of this draft that the affected systems are fully restored.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: The latest reports are Friday's expectations, not confirmation.

claim_text: A link to the week's other outages
summary: DTN reports intelligence officials told Congress on Wednesday that recent outages were separate and tied to maintenance or technical changes. No source ties USDA to the others.
detail: The FAA, NSA, Microsoft 365 and other incidents have their own pages on this site.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: No source links the USDA incident to the others.
